features: CP PLUS 2.4MP Full HD Bullet Camera – Delivers crisp 1080P resolution video for sharp and clear surveillance footage during both day and night.
Powerful Infrared Night Vision – Equipped with IR LEDs to provide clear black & white footage in total darkness, with up to 30 meters range.
3.6mm Fixed Lens – Offers a wide-angle field of view, perfect for covering broad areas like entrances, hallways, or open outdoor spaces.
Reliable Surveillance for Multiple Spaces – Perfect for monitoring homes, shops, offices, parking areas, and warehouse environments.
IP67 Weatherproof Design – Rugged body protects the camera from dust, rain, and harsh weather, ideal for both indoor and outdoor use.
description: The CP PLUS CP-URC-TC24PL3 is a 2.4MP Full HD IR Bullet CCTV Camera designed for reliable surveillance. It features a 3.6mm fixed lens, and supports an illumination range of up to 30 meters with IR night vision. The IP67-rated housing ensures it withstands harsh weather conditions, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor security applications. Compatible with analog HD DVRs, this camera is ideal for residential, office, and commercial setups.
